_help: Style presets for the Generate screen. 'suffix' is appended to the prompt after a comma. Edit freely; the app reloads this file on every visit.

styles.label: Photographic
styles.suffix: photograph, natural light, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, true-to-life colour, fine film grain

styles.label: Concept art
styles.suffix: concept art, painterly digital illustration, strong silhouette, atmospheric perspective, dramatic lighting, production design sheet quality

styles.label: Product shot
styles.suffix: studio product photography, seamless backdrop, softbox lighting, crisp reflections, centred composition, commercial catalogue quality

styles.label: Ink sketch
styles.suffix: ink sketch on white paper, confident black linework, cross-hatching, loose gestural strokes, no colour

styles.label: Screen print
styles.suffix: screen print, two to three flat spot colours, visible halftone dots, slight misregistration, bold graphic shapes, textured paper
